coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run: the character box. Drawn rule: x extent, y1 = bottom of the rule, y0 = y1 - 10.
how_measured: pdfplumber characters and filled rectangles of the filed PDF; every page looked at at 100 dpi; overlays looked at.

signing.kind: One investor completes and signs the signature page (page 9); the company accepts under it. Page 10 is the offering statement's own signatures page, already signed.

sure_per_page.10: sure (no place: the filing's own signatures, already made)

2: "February __, 2024", "August __, 2024", "October __, 2023" (twice): dates in the prose that the company completes (offering circular and termination dates)
4: "___________________." and "qualified by the SEC on ______________, 2023": the company's blanks for the offering circular link and qualification date
the yellow highlight of a paragraph (y 359-440): a drafting mark
6: the wire instructions block (highlighted yellow): ABA #, Account# and three bank lines are the company's own bank details to fill in, not the investor's
9: "Name of Authorized Signatory: Turaj Belgameh, CEO" (printed)
10: the Form 1-A signatures page of the offering statement: the company's officers, already signed /s/; "Date: September __, 2023" belongs to it; the rules under the /s/ names
